topics.title: QuickSort Algorithm
topics.question: How does QuickSort work and what is its average time complexity?

expectedAnswer.summary: QuickSort is a divide-and-conquer algorithm that selects a 'pivot' element and partitions the other elements into two sub-arrays according to whether they are less than or greater than the pivot.

visualScript.description: Show array elements with pivot highlighted in yellow, smaller elements moved to the left in cyan, and greater elements to the right in purple.

topics.title: Binary Search
topics.question: Explain Binary Search and why the array must be sorted.

expectedAnswer.summary: Binary Search repeatedly divides the search interval in half. It only works on sorted arrays because the ordering guarantees whether the target lies in the left or right half.

visualScript.description: Render array with low, mid, and high pointers adjusting at each step.
